newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Royal & Sun completes Singapore restructure.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun completes Singapore restructure.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group plc (RSA) said on Friday it had completed the reorganisation of its Singapore operations following the 1996 merger that created Britain's biggest insurer.

The merger created an insurer with annual premiums of 3.7 billion sterling and RSA said in a statement it had now completed the unificationo of the Singapore units of the former Royal Insurance and Sun Alliance Insurance companies.
"The merger signifies the birth of a new force in global insurance and a leading non-life general insurance company in Singapore," the statement said.
Edmund Lim, general manager of Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance (Singapore) Ltd, heads a team of 110.
His operation collectively wrote gross premiums of Singapore $65 million in 1996 and has a paid up capital of S$30 million.
